recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20485 unless PA later decides to define a separate Person relationship extension or resource for general person-to-person graphs.
issue_request: FHIR-20485 requested adding Person as a target for RelatedPerson.patient, or renaming that element to Person, to support Person Master Index person-to-person relationship use cases. The final Jira status is Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 70783b76e563431f31927ee0126353e67812ecab, which changed source/person/person-notes.xml in the Person Master Index section from private-sector associations or networks to associations or healthcare networks. That wording remains present in current active source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes both Person and RelatedPerson and assigns both to PA, confirming the inspected files are build inputs. PA 2021-05-12 minutes confirm the 4-0-0 not-persuasive-with-modification decision and the intended clarification that network means healthcare network, not a network of people. The Zulip thread that preceded the Jira captures the same rationale: RelatedPerson is owned by one Patient, while person-to-person relationships would belong on Person via extension or another mechanism. Later FHIR-41559 clarified RelatedPerson/Patient.link behavior but did not supersede this decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/person/person-notes.xml already contains the approved healthcare-network clarification, and source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml still defines RelatedPerson.patient as mandatory Reference(Patient), which is consistent with the final FHIR-20485 disposition.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied RelatedPerson clarification about individuals who are both RelatedPerson and Patient; it reinforces Patient.link handling without changing RelatedPerson.patient to Reference(Person).
